dashboard_subtitle: Select a class from the sidebar to get started.
dashboard_no_classes: No classes yet. Create your first class to begin.
rule_no_repeat_desc: Prevent students from sitting next to the same partner as last session.
rule_gender_mixing_desc: At least 50 % of table pairs should be mixed-gender.
rule_row_progression_desc: Students should sit in a different row than last session.
rule_positional_desc: Restrict specific students to certain row ranges.
rule_vicinity_desc: Keep specific students away from each other.
rule_front_rows_first_desc: Fill seats from the front row forward, avoiding empty rows between occupied ones.
rule_pin_to_seat_desc: Always assign a student to a specific fixed seat.
rule_seat_alone_desc: A student always occupies a table alone.
weights_position_desc: Set how strongly this student prefers each seat. 0 = avoid, 50 = neutral, 100 = strongly prefer.
weights_pair_desc: Set how desirable it is to seat this student next to others.
history_delete_confirm: Delete this session? This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_class: Delete this class and all its data? This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_student: Remove this student from the class?
no_active_students: No active students in this class.
import_error: Import failed. Check your CSV format (name, gender).
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
